name: sajha_search_my_docs
description:
Search your own documents in services you linked on Connected accounts (Google Drive, OneDrive, SharePoint, GitHub, Confluence: the sources an administrator configured), read with your own access; no LLM involved.
Returns: query, count, results (best first, each with citation, source, document, title, section, url, score and text cut to 500 characters), syncing (sources whose background refresh this call started) and not_linked (sources whose service you have not linked, with the page to link it).
Inputs (* required): query* (plain words; a question works); top_k (1-20); source (only this source).
Only signed-in users have connected accounts; a source synced for the first time returns its passages after the background sync finishes.
Example: {"query": "travel expense policy", "top_k": 5}

query.description: What to look for, in plain words (a question works).

source.description: Only this source (a name from ai.rag.accounts.sources).
